text.en: This Order may be cited as the Income Tax Act (Amendment) Order, 2017 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 1st January 2012.

Section 5 of the Act is amended by repealing subsection (1) and by substituting the following new subsection therefor - "(1) The Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, make rules to provide for -

(a) the deduction and payment of tax at the source in respect of income from any employment, and for the recovery of tax so deducted ; and

(b) such other matters as are authorised or required by this Act to be prescribed.".
